text:
## How to Protect Yourself  
✓ **Complete Training:** Finish all modules and assessments
✓ **Ask Questions:** If unsure, escalate to manager/compliance
✓ **Follow Procedures:** Use the SOPs and policies [[policy_aml]], [[policy_customer_identification]], [[policy_privacy]], etc.
✓ **Report Issues:** Don't ignore suspicious activity
✓ **Document Actions:** Keep records of what you did
✓ **Stay Updated:** Attend refresher training annually
✓ **Maintain Ethics:** Your integrity matters

raw_entities.name: Escalation of Uncertain Matters
raw_entities.description: Staff must escalate to their manager or compliance team when uncertain about procedures or compliance matters rather than proceeding without guidance. This ensures proper oversight and reduces compliance risk.
context: Ask Questions: If unsure, escalate to manager/compliance

raw_entities.description: Staff must follow established Standard Operating Procedures and organizational policies including AML, customer identification, and privacy policies. Compliance with documented procedures is mandatory.
context: Follow Procedures: Use the SOPs and policies [[policy_aml]], [[policy_customer_identification]], [[policy_privacy]], etc.

raw_entities.name: Reporting of Suspicious Activity
raw_entities.description: Staff must report suspicious activity and not ignore potential compliance concerns. This is a critical obligation for AML and fraud prevention.
context: Report Issues: Don't ignore suspicious activity

aliases: Keep records of what you did
raw_entities.description: Staff must maintain records and documentation of actions taken in relation to compliance matters, customer interactions, and suspicious activity reports. This creates an audit trail and demonstrates due diligence.
context: Document Actions: Keep records of what you did

context: Stay Updated: Attend refresher training annually
